wa2fst1m.variantName: COSTWAY 2 FT Artificial Christmas Tree with Pine Cones-Green
wa2fst1m.sourceDescription: This realistic potted tree decor is lightweight, compact and beautiful, suitable for many areas of the home including the entryway, living room and much more. If you are looking for a tree decor like this, do not hesitate to place an order! Vividly Rendered Appearance: The exquisite Christmas tree with lush branches and leaves perfectly reproduces the shape and colour of the pine tree. What’s more, pine cones are scattered between the leaves and emerald pine needles make our full Xmas tree very original. Stable Cement Base: The solid cement base provides a stable support, so you can use this decoration tree with confidence. The linen fabric on the outer layer not only makes the base more beautiful, but also effectively reduces the friction between the base and the floor or table. Safe and Durable Material: The new upgraded PVC material is odourless and non-allergenic, which is safe to use. Additionally, this material is also resistant to warping and fading, in order that the small table tree can keep fresh and beauty even in the next year. No Assemble Requirement: This tabletop Christmas trees come with different decorations that are not only abundant which make the holiday tree beautiful but are already installed on the dense branches, in order that you need not assemble them, which saves your energy and time. Multi-Functional Use: Thanks to the cones pine tree compact size and light weight, our decorative Christmas trees can be placed on tables, fireplaces and shelves as you wish for decorations. More than that, you can also send the ornaments tree to your friend as Christmas gifts. Specifications Color: Green Material: New PVC, Cement,linen Height: 60 cm Net weight: 0.75 kg Number of pine needles: 14 Number of PVC tips: 34 Box Qty:1(May vary by batch) Is Assembly Required: Yes Package includes: 1 x Tabletop Christmas tree 1 x Instruction manual Retain instructions for future reference.always place the product on a flat, steady and stable surface.keep all small parts and packaging materials for this product away from babies and children as they potentially pose a serious choking hazard. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

pjww088f.variantName: Walplus 910 Branch Tips Artificial Christmas Tree - Black - 210 cm
pjww088f.sourceDescription: Our black artificial Christmas tree forms the striking centrepiece of your Christmas decorations, creating a unique Christmas atmosphere! This Christmas tree, made of PVC material, is very lifelike in its shape and appearance. The steel feet add to its stability.
